Monzo’s standard Instant Access Savings Pot currently pays 2.80% AER (variable) on the free plan. If you pay for a Monzo plan, the rate rises to 3.15%–3.80% AER, depending on the plan.
monzo

Instant Access rates
Monzo plan	Instant Access Savings rate	Notes
Free	2.80% AER (variable)	Up to £1,000,000; paid monthly. 
monzo

Extra	3.15% AER (variable)	Paid plan. 
monzo

Plus, Premium or Perks	3.55% AER (variable)	Includes Personal, Joint and Cash ISA instant-access pots. 
monzo

Max / Max Family	3.80% AER (variable)	Highest instant-access rate. 
monzo

Interest is calculated daily and paid into the pot on the 1st of each month.
monzo

Other Monzo savings options

Select Access Savings: 3.45% AER (variable) on the free plan, or 3.70% AER with Perks, Plus, Premium, Max or Max Family. It requires a £500 minimum deposit and allows no more than two withdrawals per year per pot; a third withdrawal reduces the rate until that pot’s anniversary.
monzo

Fixed Rate Savings: up to 5.25% AER fixed for a 3-year term, with interest paid at maturity; other terms are available.
monzo

Cash ISAs: Instant Access Cash ISA pays the same instant-access rates as above, while Select Access Cash ISA pays up to 3.70% AER; ISA interest is not subject to income tax.
monzo

Important caveat

The variable rates can change, and the paid-plan rates should be weighed against the subscription cost—Extra is £3/month, Perks £9/month, and Max from £19/month. For a normal saver, the free Instant Access rate is 2.80% AER; the best simple rate without locking money away is 3.70% AER via Select Access on an eligible paid plan.
